test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Radha (female) and Gyanesh (male) have three daughters - Manuja, Tarini, and Sushma. Tarini is married to Jai and Sushma is married to Abhay. Akhil is the third son-in-law of Gyanesh. Akhil has two children Piyush and Rani. Jai has two daughters Richa and Neha. Mridul is the only son of Abhay. How is Radha related to Rani?
solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e20f8e463dec121ef2127ecd0e3d8451f6c05cbd529fd1b01640f5ba2298ffef.png] 

(1) Radha and Gyanesh have three daughters - Manuja, Tarini, and Sushma.

(2) Tarini is married to Jai and Sushma is married to Abhay. 

(3) Akhil is the third son-in-law of Gyanesh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73cff3522a90be4677b1487b2f87d48748fa80ff73ea64673159dde3d0ad77f3.png] 

(4) Akhil has two children Piyush and Rani. 

(5) Jai has two daughters Richa and Neha. 

(6) Mridul is the only son of Abhay. Thus, the final family tree is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/767e377e114fa7c7fb9cd5a104a322a79c45ea880729e8c2b06b29108f8f9946.png] 

Hence, Radha is** **the** maternal grandmother **of Rani.
